methodology: Main suite uses the unmodified game and real pointer/keyboard controls; AudioContext instrumentation records nodes and events. Supplemental loop check seeks actual media near its end. Lifecycle checks explicitly override document.hidden and dispatch visibilitychange; these are synthetic handler checks, not physical background-tab proof.
limitations: Device profiles are emulated; no physical Safari/iPhone testing.
Headless background/foreground did not establish a true document.hidden transition; lifecycle handler tested synthetically.
MP3 404 recovery is a deliberate injected-failure test.
Ordinary local-server console 404 messages did not record URLs; their cause was not established. No JavaScript exceptions or unhandled promise rejections were observed.
